title: I Gave Claude an NVDA Chart—What Did It Miss?
author: Leather-Arachnid-510
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’m building **StonksGo AI**, an Android app that uses Claude to analyze trading charts from screenshots.

For this test, I uploaded the attached NVDA chart. Claude identified:

* Bullish trend with 80% confidence
* Support near $196 and resistance near $198–$199
* A possible ascending triangle
* Bullish confirmation above $199
* Bearish confirmation below $196

I built it to show both bullish and bearish scenarios instead of giving a blind buy or sell signal.

I’d really appreciate honest feedback:

* Do the levels make sense?
* Is the pattern identification reasonable?
* Is the analysis useful or too generic?
* What important context is missing?
* What would make you distrust it?

The app is available on Android, and new users get **3 free analyses**.

**Google Play:** [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.stonksgo.ai](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.stonksgo.ai)

Please be direct. Criticism is much more useful than “looks good.”

comments.author: fomoz
comments.body: Yet another thin wrapper nobody will use.

replies.author: Leather-Arachnid-510
replies.body: Fair enough. Honestly, I built it mainly as an experiment because I wanted to create something and see whether this workflow could actually be useful.

replies.author: Spare_Subject_7069
replies.body: its not useful at all, if you could feed a picture of a chart to a LLM and have a postive equity curve over time, then. everyone would be a millionaire. There are hundreds of these ai stock analyzers, why isnt everyone rich yet?

replies.author: Leather-Arachnid-510
replies.body: That’s fair, and I agree—a chart screenshot plus an LLM isn’t a trading edge or a guarantee of profits. I built it mainly as an experiment because I wanted to create something and test whether structured analysis could be useful as a second opinion. The skepticism is completely valid.

comments.author: Mother_Story_5611
comments.body: Tried it. Clean app, useful levels, and I liked seeing both bullish and bearish scenarios.

comments.author: Patient_Ant_5409
comments.body: Recientemente desarrolle un expert para MT5 que lo arrastras al gráfico, y seleccionas el rango de las velas moviendo líneas verticales y envia automáticamente a claude o chatgpt la imagen optimizada de las velas y el array ohlc normalizado y automáticamente ya me dibuja los puntos de entrada, tp y sl. muy rápido y practico para validar entradas.
